title: Sister, Slow Dance
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: A slow-burn dream-pop ballad that opens with shimmering sine-wave chords and a warm low bass before an AkaiLinn drum machine gently enters, building through a pentatonic melody arc and full kick-and-clap groove.
